verdict: Thesis: working, not stitched. One definition drives runtime law enforcement and the generated proof models; guarantees pin each proof to the definition hash. Gaps are scope, not the idea. Today the proof side covers a narrow profile (create-only events, one law per subject); extending it to workflows is the next engineering unit.

areas.detail: Working end to end on the demo profile; proofs don't yet cover workflow (lifecycle) subjects or multiple laws per subject. That extension is next; re-proof at admission inside Workers (#757) in review.
Values, identity, queries/IVM, lineage, restatement, as-of; exact decimals everywhere.
Cedar, default-deny, writer authz, structured laws, refusals with reasons, identical on API/MCP/CLI. Studio shows recorded refusals; it has no live action path yet.
Lean kernel, Kani, generated Quint→Apalache, binder on main; demo recording landing; workflow/multi-law lowering not built yet.
Native receive→transfer→FIFO-sell runs and matches ERPNext 7/7; UI action wiring open.
Live: two-island shell, object types → records, questions, corrections, workflows as decision trees, guarantees; recorded data
ERPNext/Shopify definitions; real ERPNext on Boat; Shopify store unavailable (402); no live ingestion yet.
Better Auth deferred (#817); cell host not deployed.

On the demo deployment only: propose a definition change to a synthetic world → the server-side checker admits it or refuses it with the law and reason → you decide; its code is in review (#948, #949), not on main. Canvas editing and NornQL answers not built yet.
